It is wonderful that you have the self-awareness to recognize this pattern and the motivation to change it. Shifting away from a negative mindset is absolutely possible, but it takes time, so try to be gentle with yourself. Our brains are often wired to focus on the negative as a protective mechanism, meaning you are working to unlearn a very natural habit. 

A great first step is simply noticing your negative thoughts without judging yourself for having them. When you catch a negative thought, see if you can gently challenge it or find one small, neutral alternative. You might also try ending your day by writing down just one positive or even just "okay" thing that happened, no matter how tiny. Over time, these small shifts can help retrain your brain to notice the good alongside the bad. If this negativity ever feels too heavy to manage on your own, speaking with a counselor could also provide you with helpful tools tailored to your specific situation.
